root.name: Grünfeld Defense: Flohr Defense
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nc3 Nf6 4. e3 g6 5. Nf3 Bg7 6. Bd3 O-O 7. O-O Bf5

overview: A Slav-like set-up with ...c6, ...Nf6, ...g6 and ...Bg7 where White develops with e3, Bd3, O-O. Black's ...Bf5 offers a bishop trade on d3 and the game develops slowly with c4/d4 against c6/d5.

white_ideas.idea: Complete development and trade the light bishops
Expand with e4 or queenside play

black_ideas.idea: Fianchetto the king's bishop, trade bishops with ...Bf5
Hold d5 and challenge with ...dxc4 or ...Nbd7

typical_structures.structure: Slav/Grünfeld hybrid with c6, d5, g6 pawns

character.notes: Slow, steady game with few early tactics.

structure.notes: Tense centre with c6-d5 against c4-d4.

level.notes: Plans and move-order are subtle but little forcing theory.

character.reason: Black's Slav-style set-up is compact and hard to break down.

soundness.reason: A sound hybrid that strong players have tried.

structure.reason: The c4/d4 versus c6/d5 centre stays in tension.

approach.reason: A Slav-Grünfeld hybrid that is less common but not a trick opening.

level.reason: Plans are clear with little memorising.
